manga_title: My Wife Is From a Thousand Years Ago 238
text:
Page 001
001-1. junitius junitius CL/RD TL Paragon discord.gg/pErHvcxdrx Scans
001-2. junitius  junitius TS PR

Page 002
002-1. ARE YOU AFRAID THAT I MIGHT JUST LEAVE YOU AND RUNOFF WITH MY BAGS?
002-2. WHAT DO YOU THINK?
002-3. ..YOU ARE.

Page 003
003-1. I'M ALSO AFRAID!

Page 004
004-1. AHAHAHA! STOP IT! IT TICKLES!
004-2. WE'RE ALREADY SLEEPING ON THE SAME BED,SO YOU ARE NOT AFRAID, RIGHT?
004-3. WE'RE NOT DOING ANYTHING SLEEPINGONTHE SAME BED.
004-4. BECALISE YOU DON'T DARE TO.

Page 005
005-1. 璀雅南摩阿里雅佳 上哈拉特雅达他 I.DON'T PROVOKE ME. 噜 嘎雅萨达
005-2. 拉 哈帝
005-3. I'LL TAKE IT AS A HINT.IF I GET SERIOLSLY INJURED BY YOU, IT'LL BE OVER.
005-4. WE'RE NOT S MARRIED, WE CAN'T THAT...

Page 006
006-1. IT FEELS LIKE THE TWO OF US HAVE A WEIRD RELATIONSHIP.
006-2. WEIRD WOULD BE RIGHT.BREAKING AND RESHAPING YOURORIGINAL LOGICANDCOGNITIVEPATTERNS --THISPROCESSHASBEENMUCH FASTER THANIMAGINED.WHENMODERN IDEAS CLASHWITHYOURPREVIOUS THOUGHTS, YOU'LL EXPERIENCE THIS FEELING.THE MORE CHANGES, THE STRONGER THE CONFLICT. INSIMPLE TERMS,IT'S DUE TO THE SHORT TIME.
006-3. √2sin
006-4. √2sin2x
006-5. CAN YOUR SERIOUS AND LENGTHY TALK REALLY CONCEAL YOUR INTENTION TODO SOMETHING IN- APPROPRIATE?

Page 007
007-1. IT'S JUST INSTINCT!!
007-2. HAVINGSEXIS NOT POSSIBLE, BUT CANIRELUCTANTLY OFFER HIM A UTTLE COMFORT?
007-3. BUT HE DOESN'T SEEM TOLIKE HOLDINGFEET...
007-4. WAIT A MINUTE, JUST A FEW MONTHS AGO,IWASSTILLAGAINST HIM MOVING INTOMYROOM,AND THENONQIXI, HEKISSED ME ABUNCH. DOES BECOMING AMODERN PERSONMEANTHATOUR STANDARDSAREGETTING LOWERANDLOWER?

Page 008
008-1. ANCIENT
008-2. YOU HAVEN'T SAID WHY YOU'RE NOT AFRAID.
008-3. AHEM
008-4. I'VE NEVER BEEN AFRAID.BEFORE,I WAS JUST WORRIED THAT YOU WOULDN'TSURVIVE IN THIS WORLD, TAKING RISKSWITH A SWORDINHAND.WHETHER YOU GO OR NOT, IT'S NOT SOMETHING I CAN CONTROL.
008-5. YOU'RE LYING; YOUKNOW THATI WON'T JUST LEAVE, SO THAT'S WHY YOU'RE NOT WORRIED.
008-6. OKAY,I ADMIT WHAT YOU SAID.

Page 009
009-1. HMPH!
009-2. WOW...
009-3. WHO CAN WRITE SUICH A BOOK..?
009-4. IS THIS ALSO PART OF YOU INTRODUCING ME TO MODERN ENTERTAINMENT?

Page 010
010-1. THAT'S JUST PART OFTHE PLAN.
010-2. IWANT TO SHARE ALL THE THINGSILIKE WITH YOU.
010-3. THIS ERAINDEED HAS MANYWONDERFUL THINGS. READING A BOOK, WATCHING A MOVIE,LISTENINGTOASONG- IT'S VERY EASY TO EXPERI- ENCE A SENSEOF AWE ENCEASENSEOFAWE AND EMOTION.
010-4. THANK YOU,I LIKE IT A LOT.
010-5. THINGS HELIKE...

Page 011
011-1. I'M GOING TO TAKE A SHOWER FIRST.
011-2. AFTER I'M DONE...YOU SHOULD HURRY UP AND SHO- WER TOO.
011-3. OKAY.
011-4. I'MDONE I'M DONE SHOWERING...
011-5. PFT!!

Page 012
012-1. YOU CAN.. BUT JUSTNOT THAT....
012-2. ??? IS TODAY THECHINESE NEWYEAR?!
012-3. FORTHE NEW YEAR, IT'STMETO EATFEET.IMEAN, DUMPLINGS!
012-4. T/N: A play on how the characters sound.Part of dumplings sounds like feet(jiao).

Page 013
013-1. ooh Ahnl
013-2. T/N: Why are we here just to suffer?
013-3. SOMETHING'S NOT RIGHT, EVERYTHING WAS NORMAL BEFOREAND NOTHING WAS WRONG, SO WHYAM ISO HORNYNOW...

Page 014
014-1. I'M ACTUALLY QUITE LUSTFUL!
014-2. SO, THIS IS JUST PURE LUST, NOT PERVERSION AT ALL!
014-3. 啊哈 T/N: He's laughing.
014-4. 啊 合 哈

Page 015
015-1. I hope you enjoyed today's chapter. Thank you for reading and see you next time.
015-2. To catch the next chapter at the earliest time possible, join our discord at discord.gg/pErHvcxdrx to be alerted when it's scanlated.
